title: filago lusitanica
intro: Filago lusitanica, commonly known as Lusitanian fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to the Iberian Peninsula. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Filago lusitanica include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds may also contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
